> help
Commands:
  status - show the calendar, nations, armies and cities
  map - show the 8x6 terrain map with city, army and fleet markers
  move <army> <x> <y> - move an army toward (x, y)
  buy <army> <city> <tons> - buy supply for an army at a city (free at your own city, paid abroad)
  end - end your turn
  news - show the news log
  help - show this help
  quit - exit
Not yet implemented: battles, city capture, recruitment, diplomacy, and the AI -- a seat with no
human player simply passes with no orders.

> map
Map (8x6):
~ ~ . . . " ^ ~
~ . A , . " ^ ~
~ . = n . P " ~
N . . . ^ . . ~
~ ~ . M s . ~ S
~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~

Legend:
  A = Arx (Northern League)
  P = Portus (Northern League)
  M = Meridia (Southern League)
  n = Northern League army
  N = Northern League fleet
  s = Southern League army
  S = Southern League fleet

> move north-army-1 4 2
north-army-1 moved from (3,2) to (4,2), spending 1 of 5 moves.

> move ghost-army 0 0
Move rejected (movement.unknown-army): 'ghost-army' is not a known army.

> move south-army-1 0 0
Move rejected (movement.not-your-army): Army 'south-army-1' belongs to 'south', not 'north'.

> move north-army-1 3 -1
Move rejected (movement.out-of-bounds): (3, -1) is outside the 8x6 map.

> move north-army-1 4 4
north-army-1 moved from (4,2) to (4,3), spending 4 of 4 moves.

> move north-army-1 5 5
Move rejected (movement.no-moves-left): Army 'north-army-1' has no moves left this turn.
